name: Алхимик

geometry.method: whole-canvas continuous monotone Y inverse map; one Y resample; no masks, cut/paste segments or internal joins

mapping.coordinateConvention: continuous image edge coordinates on normalized domain[0,1417]; centers y+0.5

resampling.horizontal: Pillow.Image.Resampling.LANCZOS to width814, native height unchanged
resampling.vertical: custom nonuniform separable Lanczos3, single pass direct from horizontal-only resized accepted PNG
resampling.kernel: sinc(t)*sinc(t/3) for abs(t)<3, normalized per row
resampling.sourceBorder: clamp sample indices to nearest source row
resampling.workingRGB: encoded RGB values, float64 filtering; no explicit color transform

jpegopts.selection: highest integer quality in1..100 producing200000..300000bytes, direct from accepted PNG-derived candidate canvas

edges.independentMeasurementMethod: Both compared at814x1417 (source9_1 is normalized from951x1654); Lanczos for source resizing. Parchment vertical geometry via RGB edge/color profiles,6 columns upper ribbon and8 lower scroll. Full-width median edge excludes highlights/faces. JPEG lower-top search uses original lower-top +/-18px to avoid unrelated golden tabletop (6_2); a measured boundary near that window edge requires visual review. Positive delta means down/right. Upper top andbottom, lower top andbottom are separately measured.

independentMeasurementConfidence.note: Natural edge irregularity retained. Upper boundaries use6 constrained edge profiles; lower boundaries use full-width median directional edge and8 column profiles. Source6_2/3_3 upper lower-scroll edge is low-contrast; visual review advised if near threshold. Horizontal shadow-roll contour estimates are diagnostic and are not a pass criterion.

checks.oneYResample: pass:single continuous inverse-map Lanczos3 filter across all rows
checks.visualCompleteParchmentTextNumber: pass: full candidate card and same-size original/current/candidate parchment triptychs reviewed; all text, rank medallion, upper ribbon, lower scroll and roll complete; no visible internal seam or duplicated band
checks.deterministicReproduction: pass:repository helper executed in new temporary output directory, bytes equal accepted candidate and canonical JPEG

Accepted Alchemist PNG has slightly different parchment height. Theoretical maximum median-edge residual is 4.2289199217709665 normalized pixels; whole-canvas alignment cannot make every edge agree within 3 pixels without local edits.
Coordinates are continuous piecewise-linear across the entire canvas; derivative changes at mapping knots, with no visible seam in reviewed result.
Main art is slightly taller and lower parchment text slightly more compact vertically. No color, sharpness or text editing.
JPEG is lossy; accepted original PNG remains unchanged.
